# Test p95 calculation with nearest-rank
mkdir -p /tmp/test15
python3 -c "
import math
# Test: n=20, ceil(0.95*20) = ceil(19) = 19, so 19th element (1-based)
# n=1, ceil(0.95*1) = ceil(0.95) = 1
# n=2, ceil(0.95*2) = ceil(1.9) = 2
# n=100, ceil(0.95*100) = ceil(95) = 95
# n=101, ceil(0.95*101) = ceil(95.95) = 96
for n in [1, 2, 3, 10, 100, 101]:
    idx = math.ceil(0.95 * n)
    print(f'n={n}: idx={idx} (1-based)')
"
